Operations Research Analyst

We are looking for an operations research analyst to improve planning and service quality. In this role, you will build quantitative models, analyze operational datasets, and explain recommendations to leaders across the organization.

Requirements

Applicants should have experience with Python or R, statistical analysis, SQL, and communicating analytical results. A degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, or a related discipline is preferred. Experience with optimization, forecasting, and experimentation is useful.

The successful candidate works carefully with partners, documents assumptions, and validates results before recommending changes to business processes.
